big_case.notes: The questions (Turner deference vs. VMI heightened scrutiny for sex-based jail policies applied to a transgender detainee; cross-sex strip searches) matter nationally to correctional administration and drew a 23-State amicus brief and a CVSG. But the Court disposed of the case by a routine GVR in light of B.P.J. and Skrmetti, deciding nothing itself, and B.P.J. had already narrowed what was left of the questions. Moderate stakes, not landmark.
